item.title: Jev Router Launches MCP Aggregator Claiming 96% Cost Reduction
item.description:
AI/ML API introduced Jev Router, aggregating over 10,000 tools and models behind a single MCP server. The solution uses Typesafe's Jev engine to dynamically select optimal backends, aiming to resolve context bloat caused by hardcoded providers in agents. The vendor claims 28x higher task efficiency and 96% lower costs compared to Claude, though specific benchmark details remain unverified.

原文标题：Jev Router 发布 MCP 聚合器 宣称成本降低 96%

Why it matters：MCP 生态下的新型路由架构值得关注，但性能数据主要源自厂商营销口径，缺乏独立复现证据。

item.title: Google Unveils Genie 4 World Model with Synced Audio and Real-Time Interaction
item.description:
Google DeepMind has released Genie 4, a research preview world model capable of generating high-fidelity virtual environments with synchronized audio and real-time interactive editing. By integrating deeply with Gemini, the model doubles scene coherence to two minutes and demonstrates potential in robotic simulation testing. Despite limitations like detail drift over time, its capabilities for interactive learning and film prototyping are drawing significant industry attention.

原文标题：谷歌发布 Genie 4 世界模型，支持音视频同步与实时交互

Why it matters：Genie 4 在世界模型的物理一致性、多模态同步生成及 LLM 协同架构上取得显著突破，对具身智能与内容创作领域具有前瞻性意义。

item.title: Cartesia Voice Agents Score Higher in Arena Benchmark
item.description:
Cartesia Managed Agents achieved an Elo score of 1115 on the Artificial Analysis Speech Agent Arena, a 98-point improvement over its predecessor. Task success rates rose from 77.5% to 91.7%, driven by a cascaded architecture combining Ink STT/TTS models with GPT-5.5.

原文标题：Cartesia 语音智能体基准测试得分提升

item.title: Delaware's AI-Run Company Plan Faces Congressional Scrutiny
item.description:
The House Oversight Committee Chairman warned Delaware's Governor against a proposal to establish 'Artificial Intelligence Companies' (AICs) run by AI agents. The letter argues that such entities could allow human owners to evade legal liability for harmful AI actions and facilitate regulatory capture.

Why it matters：涉及 AI 法律主体资格与责任归属的重大政策争议，对行业合规有警示意义。

item.title: Anthropic IPO Governance Limits Public Shareholder Control
item.description:
As Anthropic approaches its IPO, its unique corporate governance structure significantly limits public shareholder control. Through mechanisms like its Public Benefit Corporation status and the Long-Term Beneficiary Trust (LTBT), founders and the board retain absolute authority over major decisions, including AI safety, leaving common investors with little influence.

原文标题：Anthropic IPO 治理结构曝光：公众股东控制权受限

Why it matters：揭示了前沿 AI 实验室在商业化过程中如何通过特殊治理架构平衡资本与控制权，对理解 AI 行业权力结构具有参考价值。

item.description:

item.title: Baoyu Argues Multi-Agent Parallel Verification is Future Trend
item.description:

Despite challenges like expectation misalignment, Agents' self-correction capabilities and low trial-and-error costs make this model an inevitable trend.

item.title: Sentient OS Launches Local AI to Process Digital Life Overnight
item.description:
YC-backed Sentient OS has launched an on-device AI system that uses local LLMs to scan user messages, files, and notes overnight. It generates editable Markdown memory files which power daytime features like Double Tap and Sidekick for drafting replies and completing tasks, reserving cloud model calls only for heavier workloads.

item.title: Chinese Team Launches Natural Language Protein Design Tool
item.description:
A Chinese research team has developed a protein design tool that accepts natural language prompts to generate proteins with specified functions, aiming to lower the barrier for non-experts. While the success rate of generated proteins remains modest and requires lab validation, this marks an extension of 'vibe coding' into bio-computation. Separately, Hugging Face launched a similar tool for DNA-level design.

item.title: Anthropic 详解 Claude 架构：分离大脑与双手实现安全智能体
item.description:

item.title: Liquid AI 发布 LFM3 开源模型家族，1.7B 文本模型性能超越前代
item.description:
Liquid AI 推出新一代开源权重模型家族 LFM3，其核心亮点在于采用“三混合”架构（短卷积、滑动窗口注意力与全局注意力结合），使 1.7B 参数文本模型在多项基准测试中显著优于其 2.6B 前代及竞品。该系列涵盖文本、视觉、音频及全模态共 6 个实例，专为端侧部署优化，并在自动化代理任务中展现出极高的效率优势。

Why it matters：LFM3 通过创新的混合架构在小参数量下实现了显著的推理效率提升和端侧可用性，对追求轻量化部署的开发者极具价值。

item.title: Google Research 提出“睡眠阶段”框架 解决 LLM 持续学习遗忘难题
item.description:
Google Research 团队在博客中提出了针对大语言模型（LLM）的“睡眠阶段”（Sleep Phase）概念，旨在解决持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。该框架模拟生物睡眠机制，允许模型在部署后通过离线整合新事实来增强推理能力，同时保持原有知识稳定，突破了传统静态知识截止日期的限制。

Why it matters：直击 LLM 落地核心痛点（灾难性遗忘），提供具有生物学启发意义的新范式，具备较高的学术与工程参考价值。
